scope: de-DE, fr-FR, es-ES, it, ja, ko only; fresh authenticated GET read of live 1.7.3 and draft 1.7.4. Existing en-US changes left untouched.

allocationDecision.names: Exact current draft identity retained for every locale, including local calendar/agenda words.
allocationDecision.subtitles: Replace generic consolidation phrasing with localized weather, appointments/planning and Home Screen widget benefits. These are relevance hypotheses, not measured demand.
allocationDecision.keywords: Allocate remaining space to planning, views, reminders, meetings, sharing/invitations and forecasts. Avoid exact title/subtitle duplication, competing app names, and provider trademarks in hidden keywords. Japanese/Korean terms remain concise rather than padded to 100.
allocationDecision.jaKoTradeoff: Current subtitle names Google, Microsoft and iCloud. Proposal replaces provider-led positioning with localized feature benefits; descriptions still name providers and explain Premium. This is a deliberate reduction in subtitle provider visibility and should be chosen consciously; no claim of ranking uplift.
allocationDecision.westernTradeoff: Current de/fr/es/it subtitles chiefly repeat the calendar consolidation promise. New subtitles foreground weather and widgets while descriptions preserve multi-calendar explanation.

qualityChecks: All names exactly equal fresh draft appInfo names.
All subtitle <=30, keyword <=100, promotional text <=170, description <=4000 Unicode code-point counts. UTF-8 byte counts reported separately.
No exact duplicate keyword terms or exact title/subtitle-token overlap. This is not a full Japanese/Korean morphological parser.
Every description covers free Base Google sync/Meet/views/weather/widgets, Advanced ad removal, Premium Microsoft/Teams, local calendar without app account, and qualified sign-in/sharing permissions.
Descriptions include auto-renewing subscription explanation and existing privacy/EULA URLs.
No new release notes, privacy declarations, URLs or native changes proposed.

confidence.caveat: Model-authored localized copy with no native-speaker review and no live ASC field submission validation. Especially review Japanese/Korean tone and matching of Base/Advanced/Premium labels to shipped UI. Subscription phrasing follows existing English structure, not a separate legal opinion.

applicationGuard: If applying later, re-read draft state and target fields first; apply only subtitle, keywords, promotionalText and description to these locale IDs, then verify readback. Names are preserved reference data, not requested updates.
files: Each locale has a -proposal.json with exact current/target fields and localization IDs plus a -description.txt; validation.json summarizes lengths; asc-current-20261021.json is fresh read evidence.
